high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing outdoors in front of a brick wall with bamboo plants growing behind it. The individual is wearing a sleeveless, knee-length dress with a floral pattern in shades of yellow and orange. The dress has a high slit on the side, revealing one leg. They are also wearing a white baseball cap and several bracelets on their left wrist. In their right hand, they are holding a small, white handbag adorned with black polka dots. The setting appears to be a garden or a backyard, given the presence of the bamboo plants and the brick wall.
